verdict.rationale: Amplitude's own docs describe Session Replay for watching real user sessions with full event and network context, and state that sensitive content can be masked. The docs never say masking is applied by default; they frame it as a control ('control what gets captured'), so the 'masked by default' part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that sensitive inputs are masked by default, detail on masking scope and configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can watch recordings of real user sessions with sensitive input masked by default

citations.quote: Watch real user sessions to understand the why behind your metrics.
Replay sessions with full event and network context.
Mask sensitive content, honor consent, and control what gets captured.
